note: The corpus every number under evals/results/ was measured against. Two SHA-256 digests over the ingested chunks: one over context_prefix + content, one over chunks.embedding rendered by Postgres as float4 text. Reproduce with `make db migrate ingest-fixture` (no provider key) followed by `make corpus-digest`; `make corpus-digest-check` compares a live ingest against this file and exits non-zero on a mismatch. The text digest alone is not sufficient — it stayed identical across the ingests on which the vector column differed, which is how a false reproducibility claim shipped once already (ADR 0003).
